comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Shared mutable state — Application.put_env/3 from input, ETS/DETS, :persistent_term, environment variables, Logger backends. One input poisoning what another sees.' Flag Application.put_env/3, System.put_env/2, :ets.insert/2, :persistent_term.put/2 when called with tainted values. Severity: Medium.

title: Elixir: detect shared mutable state poisoning (Application.put_env, ETS from tainted input)
